description: This file defines the EndsWithBinary class, a part of Twig's internal expression handling, specifically for the 'ends with' binary operation used in template expressions.

classes.name: EndsWithBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node for 'ends with' string matching in Twig templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for evaluating whether the left string ends with the right string.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator representation; in this implementation, it returns an empty string.
